title: Cover art: cutaway illustration of Gemini spacecraft, Mission Operation Report GT-4
description: Cover of NASA "MISSION OPERATION REPORT" Report No. M-913-65-04 for "GEMINI FLIGHT NUMBER FOUR (GT-4)". The dominant image is a black-and-white cutaway illustration of the Gemini spacecraft against a starry black background, revealing two crew seats, equipment and adapter-section tanks. The NASA logo, "OFFICE OF MANNED SPACE FLIGHT" and "FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY" appear at the bottom.
